title: The Little Waking Branch
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks closely, and tonight the Lord asks Jeremiah "What do you see?" and teaches him through a waking almond branch, just as Scout finds a bud on his twig.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because looking closely is how we find what Heavenly Father is quietly showing us. In Scout's world today: Scout kept a bare twig in a jar on the windowsill and checked it every morning. Most mornings, nothing. Then one morning, one tiny green bud, and he ran to show everybody. Just like Jeremiah, who saw the waking branch, Scout learned that Heavenly Father keeps every promise, even slow-looking ones.
